parameters.name: ArmLength
parameters.description: Lower control arm length, hinge to ball-joint.

parameters.name: SpringRest
parameters.description: Free length of the strut spring.

parameters.name: RoadAmp
parameters.description: Peak vertical force the road profile applies to the wheel.

parameters.name: RoadFreq
parameters.description: Excitation frequency of the rolling-road profile, in Hz.

parameters.name: QuarterCarLoad
parameters.description: Static load representing the quarter-car weight on this corner.

fy.expression: RoadAmp * sin(360 deg * RoadFreq * t / 1 s)
